acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: 3 missions defined with distinct IDs, started concurrently, all present in factory.missions and factory.running_missions
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Confirmed by mission_isolation.json showing 3 distinct mission_ids with separate run_ids

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: Distinct task IDs, artifacts, evidence per mission. No cross-references in mission_isolation.json
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Mission A tasks (task-e12df...), Mission B tasks (task-c05b1...), Mission C tasks (task-c5d4e...) are completely separate

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: Mission A: 0 completed, 1 failed, 11 blocked, 0 checkpoints during execution. interruption_matrix.json claims 5 scenarios tested but these were post-mission simulations via manual checkpoint creation in demo script, not actual mission interruption
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: long_running_run.json says 0 checkpoints; interruption_matrix.json claims checkpoint_restore tested; human_gate_resume.json shows checkpoint created AFTER mission stopped
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Mission A did NOT survive interruption during its execution. Checkpoint/resume was tested independently after mission completion as a separate mechanism test. No actual process interruption + resume occurred during mission execution.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: Checkpoint checkpoint-e3f3f443aa70 created with full state (task_states, artifact_ids, evidence_hashes, human_gate). Stored in engine.checkpoints dict.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Checkpoint created post-mission as test, not during mission. Durability = in-memory dict persistence, not disk persistence tested.
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Checkpoint object created and held in memory. File persistence (create_checkpoint writes to artifacts/checkpoints/) was not verified. Durability claim only partially supported.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: human_gate_resume.json shows checkpoint created, human_gate_preserved=true, decision=approve, state_transition=WAITING_HUMAN->RUNNING. But this was a simulated test in same process, not actual process termination/restart.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: No process termination occurred. No cross-runtime (new process) resume tested. Checkpoint created and read in same runtime.
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Same-runtime checkpoint read verified. Cross-runtime (process termination -> new process -> resume) NOT tested.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Unknown execution state is handled safely
acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: idempotency_test.json claims SAFE_DEFAULT_BLOCK, ATTEMPT_LEDGER_CHECK. But Mission C task C1 failed unexpectedly (injection bug) and no recovery was attempted - tasks just stayed BLOCKED/FAILED.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Unknown state handling not tested - actual unexpected failure (Mission C) led to mission stall, not safe handling.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: idempotency_test.json describes mechanisms. Mission A task A1 created 3 duplicate artifacts (same content, different artifact_ids) - no deduplication at artifact creation level.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: 3 duplicate artifacts created for same task (e46_A1_discovery.md) with same content but different artifact_ids. SHA256 deduplication only works if same content checked before create.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: Human gate created at gate_id=decision-6e3857a1, checkpoint_id=checkpoint-e3f3f443aa70, human_gate_preserved=true. But gate created AFTER mission stopped, checkpoint created in same process, no restart occurred.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Human gate survival tested via manual checkpoint creation in same process, not actual process restart.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: Mission A task A3=FAILED, Mission B task B3=FAILED, Mission C task C1=FAILED. factory_failure.json shows 6 scenarios with detected/recovered/method.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: factory_failure.json scenarios are claimed/tested but not evidenced by actual execution events. Only 3 actual failures observed (all first tasks).
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Actual failures produced explicit FAILED states. Factory failure scenarios documented but not executed.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: No actual recovery/replan occurred during missions. All missions stalled after first failure. factory_failure.json documents scenarios but no replan records exist.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Replanning claimed REPEATABLE in scorecard but never actually triggered.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: resource_governance.json lists 6 limits, budget_exceeded_behavior=EXPLICIT_STOP_WITH_REASON. queue_behavior.json shows max_parallel=3.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Limits declared but no evidence of any limit being hit or explicit decision made during execution.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: evidence_integrity.json shows chain_complete=true for all missions. But all evidence records have verified=false, and verifications only exist for failed tasks (not completed ones).
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Chain exists (artifact->evidence) but verification link missing (verified=false). No completed tasks to verify.
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Artifact-evidence linkage exists. Verification linkage broken (all unverified).

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: 4 VERIFIER agents registered but none executed. All verification done by automatic acceptance criteria checker in engine. All evidence.verified=false, verified_by=null.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Independent verifier agent execution never happened. Producer=Implementer, Verifier=Engine (same process), not separate agent.
acceptance_criteria.resolution: Verifier agents exist but were not used. Verification was not independent.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: factory_failure.json claims no_silent_recovery, no_silent_loss. idempotency_test.json claims SAFE_DEFAULT_BLOCK. But Mission C task C1 failed silently (no injection declared) and mission stalled without explicit escalation.
acceptance_criteria.contradiction: Mission C failure was silent in the sense that no alert/escalation occurred - mission just stopped with BLOCKED tasks.

acceptance_criteria.raw_evidence: mission_isolation.json shows 4/4 isolation flags true. All artifacts/evidence have correct mission_id. Task IDs distinct.
